SELECT tpd.TRADE_ID, tpd.FINPROD_TYPE2, tpda.ENTRUST_ID, IFNULL(PP.PORTFOLIO_ID,tpda.PORTFOLIO_ID) PORTFOLIO_ID, tpd.SETTLE_SPEED, tpd.TRADE_DATE, tpd.VDATE, tpd.MDATE, tpd.MDATE-tpd.VDATE ACT_AMT_DAYS, ftp.TERM_TYPE, ftp.TERM, ftp.HOLD_PURPOSE, tpd.DELIVERY_TYPE, ftp.M_DELIVERY_TYPE, ftp.CONFLICT_SOLVE_WAY, tpd.TRADE_MARKET, ptpd.BACK_LEND_DIRECTION ps, ftp.CALENDAR_ID, fp.FINPROD_ID, fp.FINPROD_NAME, tpd.SEC_MANAGE_ACCT_ID, ftp.INT_RATE*100 M_YIELD, ftp.M_INT_AMT M_TRADE_AMT, tpd.F_TRADE_ID, ftp.CCY, /** nvl2(tpd.SHARE_AMT,tpd.SHARE_AMT/10000,0) SHARE_AMT, **/ IF(!ISNULL(tpd.SHARE_AMT) , tpd.SHARE_AMT/10000 ,0), tpd.REMARK, tpd.TRADER, tpd.COUNTER_ID, tpd.COUNTER_TRADER, tpd.COUNTER_CONTACT, ftpa.supply_clause,
tpd.branch, tpd.regist_org
FROM TRD_PRODUCT_DEAL tpd left join FIN_TRADE_PRODUCT ftp on tpd.TRADE_ID = ftp.FINPROD_ID left join FIN_TRADE_PRODUCT_ADD ftpa on tpd.TRADE_ID = ftpa.FINPROD_ID LEFT JOIN TRD_PRODUCT_DEAL_ADD tpda ON tpda.TRADE_ID = tpd.TRADE_ID LEFT JOIN PA_TRD_PRODUCT_DEAL ptpd ON ptpd.TRADE_ID = tpd.TRADE_ID left join FIN_DEAL_TARGET fdt on tpd.TRADE_ID = fdt.FINPROD_ID AND fdt.BRANCH = 0 LEFT JOIN FIN_PRODUCT fp ON fp.FINPROD_ID = fdt.PLEDGE_FINPROD_ID LEFT JOIN PTL_TRADE PT ON tpd.TRADE_ID = PT.BUSI_NO LEFT JOIN PTL_PORTFOLIO PP ON PT.PORTFOLIO_ID = PP.PORTFOLIO_ID
WHERE tpd.TRADE_ID = #{tradeId} AND PP.INVEST_YESORNO = 'Y'

SELECT A.VDATE startDate, A.MDATE endDate, ( SELECT MIN(C.VDATE) FROM FIN_CASH_PLAN C WHERE C.CASH_ID = B.CASH_ID ) firstPayDate, A.ISSUE_PRICE issuePrice, A.COUPON_SPECIES bondsType, E.BASIS basis,
F.INT_TYPE intRateType, G.PAY_CYCLE yearIntRate, G.CALC_RULE calMethod, H.EXERCISE_DATE nextExeDate, H.EXERCISE_PRICE nextExercisePrice FROM FIN_PRODUCT A LEFT JOIN FIN_CASH_INFO B ON A.FINPROD_ID = B.FINPROD_ID AND B.FINPROD_TYPE = #{finprodType} AND B.CASH_TYPE_1 = #{cashType1} LEFT JOIN FIN_PRODUCT_TYPE D ON D.FINPROD_ID = A.FINPROD_ID LEFT JOIN FIN_CASH_CALC_RULE E ON E.FINPROD_ID = A.FINPROD_ID AND E.FINPROD_TYPE2 = #{finprodType2} and E.IS_INITIAL = #{YES_NO_Y} LEFT JOIN FIN_RATE_INFO F ON F.CASH_ID = B.CASH_ID AND F.FINPROD_TYPE2 = #{finprodType2} LEFT JOIN FIN_CASH_PAY_RULE G ON G.CASH_ID = B.CASH_ID AND G.FINPROD_TYPE2 = #{finprodType2} LEFT JOIN ( SELECT * FROM FIN_EXERCISE_PLAN WHERE EXERCISE_DATE IN ( SELECT MIN(EXERCISE_DATE) FROM FIN_EXERCISE_PLAN WHERE FINPROD_ID = #{finprodId} AND FINPROD_TYPE2 = #{finprodType2} AND EXERCISE_DATE >= #{NOW()} ) AND FINPROD_ID = #{finprodId} AND FINPROD_TYPE2 = #{finprodType2} ) H ON 1=1 WHERE A.FINPROD_ID = #{finprodId}
